title: Daily World Cup Quiz
description: A fresh quiz every match day. Come back daily and keep your streak.

questions.q: The 2026 World Cup opening match is played in which city?
questions.explain: The opener is at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City.

questions.q: Who are the defending world champions heading into 2026?
questions.explain: Argentina won in 2022 and defend their title.

questions.q: Which confederation gets the most guaranteed 2026 slots after expansion?
questions.explain: UEFA has 16 direct slots in the 48-team format.

questions.q: How long does the 2026 tournament run?
questions.explain: The expanded format stretches across roughly 5–6 weeks.

questions.q: Lionel Messi made his World Cup debut in which year?
questions.explain: Messi debuted at the 2006 World Cup in Germany.
